hypotheses.rationale: Validation loss becomes unusually low after epoch 2 (0.01) then rises in epoch 3, a pattern typical when validation examples are also seen during training, causing the model to memorize them. The exact‑match score stays equal to the reference, suggesting the overlap does not improve generalisation.

With three epochs the validation loss reaches a minimum at epoch 2 and increases at epoch 3, indicating over‑training. Too many epochs can cause the model to repeat training answers without gaining new generalisation.
